name: Reconciliation engine
problem: Match bank transactions to ledger entries with fuzzy rules, explain each match, surface exceptions.
limits: Synthetic financial data only. Integer cents avoid rounding ambiguity; currency and amount must match exactly before fuzzy description/date comparison. Ambiguous candidates are surfaced rather than forced. Injected amount changes and missing entries reduce match rate intentionally. False-match rate uses the generated pairing labels; it is not a production estimate. Every accepted match has a score and explanation in evidence/reconciliation.json. Processing order can affect conflicts; global optimal assignment remains Next.
next: Add global assignment, partial payments and separately calibrated candidate scoring.
